_paramGuide.monthlyWeights: RF전기모델 전용. 온도 외 잔여 행동 패턴 보정 (재택률, 방학, 연말 등). 온도에 의한 소비 변화는 appliance 모델이 별도 처리하므로 여기선 제외할 것. 범위 0.95~1.10 권장.
_paramGuide.model.lrSeasonalFactors: LR모델 전용. 온도 포함 전체 계절 효과를 하나로 반영. usage와 bill 모두에 적용됨. 범위 0.85~1.20 권장.
_paramGuide.model.monthlyAverageTemperatures: RF전기모델 기본 온도(°C). appliance별 소비량 계산에 사용. 필리핀 월별 평균기온 기준.
_paramGuide.rateMode: 필수. 'totalRate' = 공식 발표 총요율(totalRateKwh)에서 기타요금을 역산. 'itemized' = otherChargesPerKwh를 직접 사용. totalRateKwh가 있는 provider는 반드시 'totalRate'로 설정할 것.
_paramGuide.totalRateKwh: rateMode='totalRate'일 때 필수. 전력사 공식 발표 총 요율(PHP/kWh, VAT 미포함). calculator가 이 값에서 generation·distribution·transmission·systemLoss·subsidy를 빼서 기타요금(metering, UC, FIT-All 등)을 역산함.
_paramGuide.otherChargesPerKwh: rateMode='itemized'일 때 사용. metering·UC·FIT-All 등 개별 항목별로 직접 합산한 kWh당 기타요금. totalRateKwh가 없는 provider에서만 사용.
_paramGuide.basicCharge: 월 고정 기본요금(PHP). kWh 무관하게 매월 부과. 계산식: subtotal에 고정값으로 합산.
_paramGuide.tiers[].ratePerKwh: 구간별 발전요금(PHP/kWh). 사용량에 따라 해당 구간 요율 적용. 모든 tier가 동일 요율이면 단일구간.
_paramGuide.transmissionCharge: 송전요금(PHP/kWh). NGCP 요금 포함. 계산식: usageKwh × transmissionCharge.
_paramGuide.subsidyCharge: 보조금요금(PHP/kWh). ERC lifeline subsidy 등. 계산식: usageKwh × subsidyCharge.

_rateFormula.description: calculator.ts의 요금 계산식 요약. JSON 업데이트 시 각 필드가 어디에 쓰이는지 참조용.
_rateFormula.totalRate_mode: otherPerKwh = totalRateKwh - (generationCharge / usageKwh) - distributionCharge - transmissionCharge - systemLossRate - subsidyCharge
_rateFormula.subtotal: generationCharge + (usageKwh × distributionCharge) + (usageKwh × transmissionCharge) + (usageKwh × systemLossRate) + (usageKwh × subsidyCharge) + (usageKwh × otherPerKwh) + basicCharge
_rateFormula.note_blendedRate: totalRate 모드에서는 실제 tier별 blended generation rate를 사용하여 역산하므로, multi-tier provider에서도 정확한 기타요금을 도출함.

notes.en: Meralco May 2026 rate officially confirmed at 14.3345/kWh (announced May 13). VECO May 2026 confirmed at 12.88/kWh. Davao Light May 2026 confirmed at 10.35/kWh (billing May 12–June 10). CEBECO confirmed at February 2026 level (13.37/kWh) — March/April/May not officially published. ERC suspended GEA-All collection (P0.0371/kWh) for May–June 2026 across all DUs. June rates to be announced around June 10–12.
notes.tl: Opisyal na nakumpirma ang Meralco rate para Mayo 2026 sa 14.3345/kWh (inianunsyo Mayo 13). VECO Mayo 2026 kumpirmado sa 12.88/kWh. Davao Light Mayo 2026 kumpirmado sa 10.35/kWh. CEBECO nananatili sa antas ng Pebrero 2026 (13.37/kWh). Sinuspinde ng ERC ang GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) para Mayo–Hunyo 2026.
notes.ceb: Opisyal nga nakumpirma ang Meralco rate para Mayo 2026 sa 14.3345/kWh (gipahibalo Mayo 13). VECO Mayo 2026 nakumpirma sa 12.88/kWh. Davao Light Mayo 2026 nakumpirma sa 10.35/kWh. CEBECO nagpabilin sa lebel sa Pebrero 2026 (13.37/kWh). Gi-suspend sa ERC ang GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) para Mayo–Hunyo 2026.

notes.en: Based on official May 2026 announcement (May 13). Total rate 14.3345/kWh (−0.0151 from April's 14.3496). Generation charge 8.7942/kWh (+0.4078, driven by WESM line rental surge +P7.7239/kWh and peso depreciation affecting 99% of First Gas/Prime CoreGen costs). ERC allowed PSA line rental caps, with suppliers absorbing a substantial portion, pulling PSA charges down by P0.1793/kWh to partially offset. Transmission charge 1.4074/kWh (−0.0493). ERC suspended GEA-All collection (P0.0371/kWh) for May–June 2026. AWAT refund doubled to P0.4278/kWh (from P0.2024) — ERC directed full P14.2B refund in 12 months instead of 2 years. VAT exemption for indigenous natural gas (RA 12120) partially applied. Distribution charge frozen since August 2022.
notes.tl: Batay sa opisyal na anunsyo noong Mayo 13, 2026. Kabuuang rate na 14.3345/kWh (−0.0151 mula sa 14.3496 noong Abril). Generation charge 8.7942/kWh (+0.4078). Transmission charge 1.4074/kWh (−0.0493). Sinuspinde ng ERC ang koleksyon ng GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) para Mayo–Hunyo 2026. AWAT refund dinoblo sa P0.4278/kWh. Distribution charge hindi nagbago mula Agosto 2022.
notes.ceb: Gibase sa opisyal nga pagpahibalo niadtong Mayo 13, 2026. Total rate 14.3345/kWh (−0.0151 gikan sa 14.3496 sa Abril). Generation charge 8.7942/kWh (+0.4078). Transmission charge 1.4074/kWh (−0.0493). Gi-suspend sa ERC ang koleksyon sa GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) para Mayo–Hunyo 2026. AWAT refund gidoble sa P0.4278/kWh. Distribution charge wala nausab sukad Agosto 2022.

notes.en: May 2026 total rate 12.88/kWh officially confirmed (+0.31 from April's 12.57). Rate history: Feb 12.79 → Mar 12.36 → Apr 12.57 → May 12.88. Increase attributed to higher generation costs from global fuel prices and NGCP Red/Yellow Alerts in the Visayas Grid (thin reserves, elevated demand). ERC Resolution No. 2 applied: subsidyCharge 0.01/kWh. Generation tiers are proportionally scaled estimates.
notes.tl: Opisyal na nakumpirma ang rate na 12.88/kWh para Mayo 2026 (+0.31 mula sa 12.57 noong Abril). Kasaysayan: Peb 12.79 → Mar 12.36 → Abr 12.57 → Mayo 12.88. Nailapat ang ERC Resolution No. 2: subsidyCharge 0.01/kWh. Ang generation tiers ay proportionally scaled estimates.
notes.ceb: Opisyal nga nakumpirma ang rate nga 12.88/kWh para Mayo 2026 (+0.31 gikan sa 12.57 sa Abril). Kasaysayan: Peb 12.79 → Mar 12.36 → Abr 12.57 → Mayo 12.88. Giaplikar ang ERC Resolution No. 2: subsidyCharge 0.01/kWh. Ang generation tiers proportionally scaled estimates.

notes.en: February 2026 total rate of 13.37/kWh officially confirmed (CERA announcement, +1.30). March rate not yet confirmed. Higher surcharges typical of rural cooperatives. ERC Resolution No. 2 applied: subsidyCharge 0.01/kWh. Generation and transmission charges are reverse-calculated estimates.
notes.tl: Opisyal na nakumpirma ang kabuuang rate na 13.37/kWh noong Pebrero 2026 (anunsyo ng CERA, +1.30). Hindi pa nakumpirma ang rate sa Marso. Mas mataas ang mga surcharge dahil sa katangian ng mga rural cooperative. Nailapat ang ERC Resolution No. 2: subsidyCharge 0.01/kWh. Ang generation at transmission charges ay mga tinatayang halaga.
notes.ceb: Opisyal nga nakumpirma ang total rate nga 13.37/kWh sa Pebrero 2026 (CERA announcement, +1.30). Wala pa makumpirma ang rate sa Marso. Mas taas ang mga surcharge tungod sa kinaiya sa rural cooperatives. Giaplikar ang ERC Resolution No. 2: subsidyCharge 0.01/kWh. Ang generation ug transmission charges mga gitantya nga kantidad.

notes.en: Based on official May 2026 announcement (billing May 12–June 10). Total rate 10.35/kWh (−0.18 from April's 10.53). Rate history: Jan 11.72 → Feb 10.30 → Mar 10.63 → Apr 10.53 → May 10.35. Decrease driven by lower NGCP transmission charges and ERC suspension of GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) for May–June 2026. Generation charge stable (NPC-PSALM hydro 50%, Therma South coal 20–30%). ERC Resolution No. 2 applied: lifeline subsidy P0.01/kWh. Generation tiers are reverse-calculated estimates (unchanged — decrease absorbed by otherPerKwh via totalRate formula).
notes.tl: Batay sa opisyal na anunsyo para Mayo 2026 (billing Mayo 12–Hunyo 10). Kabuuang rate na 10.35/kWh (−0.18 mula sa 10.53 noong Abril). Kasaysayan: Ene 11.72 → Peb 10.30 → Mar 10.63 → Abr 10.53 → Mayo 10.35. Pagbaba dahil sa mas mababang NGCP transmission charges at pagsuspinde ng ERC sa GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) para Mayo–Hunyo 2026. Nailapat ang ERC Resolution No. 2: lifeline subsidy na P0.01/kWh.
notes.ceb: Gibase sa opisyal nga pagpahibalo para Mayo 2026 (billing Mayo 12–Hunyo 10). Total rate 10.35/kWh (−0.18 gikan sa 10.53 sa Abril). Kasaysayan: Ene 11.72 → Peb 10.30 → Mar 10.63 → Abr 10.53 → Mayo 10.35. Pagkunhod tungod sa ubos nga NGCP transmission charges ug gi-suspend sa ERC ang GEA-All (P0.0371/kWh) para Mayo–Hunyo 2026. Giaplikar ang ERC Resolution No. 2: lifeline subsidy nga P0.01/kWh.
